headline: Park Medi World submits SEBI LODR disclosure to NSE
hook: Compliance filing by Park Medi World
summary: Park Medi World Limited filed a disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements. The filing is a routine compliance update confirming the company meets reporting obligations. It may affect shareholders of Park Medi World but carries limited market impact. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note it as a standard regulatory filing.
